messages:
sylvia_partner_ops: Heads-up — Sigma (marketplace SI) is seeing repeated 500s from the dedicated connector. They want a shared war-room and a clear SEV routing map. Can we confirm who owns the initial triage and what channel we create?
anna_pm: Copy. Is this P1 for Sigma (production impact)? Need to know comm expectations.
mohit_sales: Sigma is Tier-A marketplace; treat as P1 for production outages. I'll loop in their AE and partner-eng lead. cc @lucas_sre for SRE oncall.
lucas_sre: Oncall here, I can take lead. Proposed flow: create a shared channel (#partner-sigma-sev-<ts>), invite partner contacts + SRE + partner-ops + eng lead. PagerDuty incident should have tag partner:sigma and link to the channel. Triage owners: SRE -> eng -> partner-eng.
isabel_engineering: Also flagging a fallback policy: if Dedicated connector consistently fails, route traffic to hosted variant r-1 automatically and notify partner. Adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-sigma-sev (internal).
sylvia_partner_ops: I'll create the channel now and invite the lists. Can someone paste the initial checklist for the war-room (what we want pinned)?
mohit_sales: Checklist: 1) customer impact statement, 2) recent deploys, 3) logs and sample request IDs, 4) mitigation toggle (route to hosted), 5) comms owner. I'll handle comms with Sigma. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: War room created -> #partner-sigma-sev-2076543210. PagerDuty incident PD-4321 created and linked. Auto-notifications to oncall and partner-ops enabled.
lucas_sre: Proposed SLA for the war-room: ack within 10m, triage within 30m, mitigation plan in 90m. If blocked >2h escalate to Eng Manager + Product + Sales. Any objections?
sylvia_partner_ops: No objections, agreed. Also add handback criteria to pinned note: full verification of customer flows, canary for 24h, documented RCA, and postmortem within 72h.
anna_pm: I'll add a shared status doc and pin link -> https://drive.redwood/reports/sigma-sev-state (internal). Please keep live timeline updates there.
mohit_sales: I'll coordinate joint customer updates and check whether the planned marketplace announcement needs to be postponed.
lucas_sre: Pinned initial runbook + checklist in the channel. I've added SRE oncall, eng lead, partner-ops, and the pager link. Next steps: collect sample request IDs and deploy logs; isabel, can you take the logs?
isabel_engineering: On it — grabbing logs and rolling back suspect deploy candidate locally, will post findings in the channel in 15m.
sylvia_partner_ops: Thanks all. Scheduling a quick tabletop for handback procedure tomorrow 9am PT to refine the routing map and SLA windows. Will post invite.
mohit_sales: Thanks — I'll keep Sigma updated with the war-room link and expected cadence.
lucas_sre: Great. Keep channel focused on triage updates only; use thread for long discussion. Closing note: once mitigated, follow the handback checklist before closing PD incident.
sylvia_partner_ops: Closing loop here — war-room active, owners assigned. Will follow up with postmortem draft after RCA.
